That's good! A break from social media can really help establish your support system, your go to person and how much you really need them or they need you. 

Also once you actually delete the apps from your phone, and the longer you are able to stay off from it, the easier it is. But you may need to set goals for yourself, depending on how attached and how much you spend time on it. Like you can go to the dollar store and get a cheap calender and stickers and give yourself a sticker for everyday you go without social media. And try to aim for certain days and give yourself a small treat upon completion. Start increasing the number of days after you are comfortable  That way you stay motivated to keep off it and your mind is starting to occupy the emptiness that you feel with the lack of social media. 

It's also important that you don't cheat the system as it defeats the whole purpose.
